title: Passive MTConnect/OPC-UA telemetry capture (PRE-SHIP for MS9 training data)
brief: Split from MS22 per V3.1 pass-3 finding (risk-hunter 4/5): MS9 safety gate would otherwise be trained on synthetic-only data and miss real chatter/wire-break/thermal-drift events on first real jobs. This MS captures READ-ONLY telemetry (no actuation path exposed) on 1 mill + 1 lathe + 1 WEDM during pilot ramp-up so MS9 trains on real distributions. Active feedback (closed loop) split into MS22b post-pilot.

units.title: MTConnect/OPC-UA streaming subscriber (read-only, no actuation surface)
exit_conditions: streaming subscribers attached to 1 mill + 1 lathe + 1 WEDM
10 Hz event rate, backpressure-safe (drop oldest if consumer lags >500ms)
verifiable: tcpdump shows 0 outbound write-back to any machine (read-only proven)
tests: 3-minute stream produces 1800 events ±5; backpressure scenario drops correctly
units.description: Read-only is the safety property — no control surface exposed. Reuses existing MTConnect/OPC-UA dispatchers; adds streaming endpoint + buffer.

units.title: Label captured events in outcome ledger with job correlation for MS9/MS18
exit_conditions: each event tagged with active job_id, operation_id, tool_id from MS3 pipeline state
labels: nominal | chatter_suspected | overload | tool_break | wire_break | thermal_drift
tests: 100 staged events round-trip with correct labels; 5 known-bad-but-mislabeled cases trigger BLOCK
units.description: Closed-loop label matching to job state. MS18 LoRA training pipeline + MS9 calibration consume these events.

acceptance: read-only MTConnect/OPC-UA streams from 3 machines logged with job correlation; 100 staged events round-trip with correct labels; ledger feeds MS9 calibration AND MS18 LoRA training; no write-back path exposed (verified via packet capture); satisfies V3.1 pass-3 mitigation for MS9-trained-on-synthetic risk.

risks.description: JM Die machines may not all support MTConnect; mitigation = 1-machine fallback + synthetic data augmentation flagged as such in ledger
Operator pushback on telemetry capture (privacy/surveillance concern); mitigation = telemetry is per-machine not per-operator; opt-in per shift; documented in operations runbook
